literal_meaning: বোমের কাছে যাওয়া (to go to the bomb)
figurative_meaning_en: to be taken aback or stunned
example_sentences_in_bangla: খবরটা শুনে সে বোমকে চলে গেল।
আকস্মিক ঘটনায় সবাই বোমকে যাওয়ার মতো হতচকিত হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He was taken aback upon hearing the news.
Everyone was stunned like they had gone to the bomb by the sudden event.
note: The idiom evokes a sense of sudden shock, possibly alluding to the explosive impact of a bomb metaphorically.
